promptTemplate: Use case: background-extraction. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an existing original Diademfall character illustration. Remove ONLY its environment/background and return the SAME character artwork as a clean isolated transparent PNG cutout. Preserve the character's exact identity, species, face, expression, pose, anatomy, costume, armor, colors, dark outlines, cel shading, weapons, carried items and framing. Keep familiars or mounts that are part of this character, and retain subject-attached magical effects such as glowing hands, energy weapons, wings, smoke forming the creature, or a spirit body. Remove sky, scenery, architecture, trees, landscape, floor, ground rocks not part of the creature, and disconnected decorative background shards or swirls. Preserve the original crop; do not invent missing feet or limbs. Do not redesign, recolor, beautify, add props, change the pose, or add a card frame. No text, badges, numbers, logos, UI, watermark, ground shadow, new scene or solid background. Every pixel outside the isolated subject must have real alpha transparency, including gaps between limbs and props. Keep a portrait canvas and the original artwork's proportions.
promptSuffix: Character to preserve: {name} ({id}). This is a cutout of the supplied art, not a new illustration.
